Top: running title ornament and title block (DE / RATIONE CONTEXEN-DARVM EPI-STOLARVM, Pars I., italic subtitle), then the body in one column with a drop-cap opening. main_text.head: DE RATIONE CONTEXEN-DARVM EPI-STOLARVM
Pars I.

head.i: Deliberatiui generis: & quidem primò Commendatitias Epistolas continens.

main_text.p: PRINCEPS inter Epistolas iis maximè deberi locus videtur, quae ad Deliberatiuum referuntur genus, propterea, quòd nihil, vel honestius, vel utilius, vel necessarium magis, quàm de nota, quod aiunt, meliore eos, quos charos habemus, commendare: à turpitudine ad honestatem flectere: ad utilitatem traducere à damno: rogare: consolari: suadere iisdem aliquid aut dissuade-De Delibera-tiui generis E-pistolis cur pri-mo loco aga-tur.

page.notes: Catchword "à" is at the foot, centred under the last line. The marginal note is printed in italic and split across four lines with hyphens; it is joined here as one note. The opening word is set in small capitals with a woodcut initial P, so it is given as PRINCEPS. The page number is printed as an old-style "1" at the head. The title "CONTEXEN-DARVM" and "EPI-STOLARVM" keep their printed hyphens.
